def worker(self) -> None:
    """
    Thread worker to perform internal update checking and update GUI
    status if a newer version is found.
    :return: None
    """
    newversion = self.check_appcast()

    if newversion:
        status_widget = self.root.nametowidget('.{}.status'.format(appname.lower()))
        status_widget['text'] = newversion.title + ' is available'
        self.root.update_idletasks()
